description: Revoke compressed attestation via Squads v4 proposal. Cria proposal no vault[3] Compliance Authority chamando compliance-registry-pinocchio::revoke_compressed (selector 0x04). Aguarda 2-of-3 approve + 24h time-lock antes de execute. Retorna proposal PDA pra members assinarem em squads-cli.

expectedOldLeafHashHex.description: 32-byte leaf hash do oldLeaf (retornado por fetch_composed_attestation).

oldLeafHex.description: 252-byte AttestationLeaf serializado (hex). Buscar via fetch_composed_attestation primeiro.

revokeReason.description: Reason code 0..255 (mapping em docs/GOVERNANCE.md). Ex: 1=fraud detected, 2=user request LGPD Art. 18.

squadsMultisigPubkey.description: Squads v4 multisig PDA (vault[3] Compliance Authority) — lookup em scripts/squads-config.json.

name: revoke_composed_attestation
